rationale: Optimal dispatch minimizes cost by using minimum feasible diesel active power (14 MW, constrained by inverter availability of 20 MW) and setting diesel reactive power to its preferred value (4 MVar) to avoid penalty. Inverter supplies remaining 20 MW active and 8 MVar reactive power, respecting its 24 MVA apparent power limit. Voltage is computed as 0.965 + 0.0025 * 12 = 0.995 pu, within [0.95, 1.05] limits.
